digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler process status and bridge CLI
propositions: Canonical bridge surface must emit only exit codes 0 (benign/converged/paused/in-flight/reschedule/legacy-gated), 1 (operational failure), or 2 (invalid invocation/configuration) while legacy reconcile routes retain historical 3/4/75 translations
A single typed core disposition must classify both canonical (0/1/2) and legacy (0/3/4/75/1/2) outcomes without double-running operations or mutating repository state differently between routes

Legacy CLI reconcile --mode and direct engine --mode entrypoints must preserve their historical numeric translations and defaults to avoid breaking systemd, Jenkins, workflow revisions, and shell scripts during rolling deployment

Workflow .github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml must use canonical bridge invocation with 0/1/2 handling while retaining exact paused commit-skip behavior and allowing older checked-out workflows to continue receiving codes they understand

All in-tree consumers of exit codes 3, 4, or 75 must be migrated to canonical surface or explicitly classified as legacy compatibility, with no production sentinel handlers for numeric exit codes outside the legacy adapter
